searchText: Yesterday, I went over the Electra/Prague thread on EthMag (and the CL github issue) and both updated the thread with a summary, but also put the proposals so far in visual form. Figured it could be valuable to share here. A couple of my takeaways: - On the EL side, we have more proposals to sort through than on the CL, although the CL has a greater share of proposals that could affect the EL vs. completely independent ones. - Both Verkle and DAS are big enough to probably be their own, largely unique, forks, but nothing else appears to be (although larger clusters such as EOF and SSZ could, in aggregate). We can get into this more on ACDE, but hopefully this provides a good basis for teams to start using for prioritization! Do other clients apart from Geth have an `evm` utility/binary that I could feed a prestate, some calldata and benchmark their performance? For a single call, ala `evm t8n`? Or something fancier? Replied to your tweet Edit: https://x.com/peter_szilagyi/status/1747359574036824497?s=20. Ah I see. What's your ideal use cases beyond that? We can quickly spin something up One idea would be a simple `evm --genesis <...> --calldata <...>` binary, is that enough? Besu's `evmool` supports that. but beware the JVM startup cost and warm up time if you're only executing a single transaction in the process. It can easily swamp your benchmark timings. That's why we have the `--repeat` flag. And we report EVM time as part of the response logic. It is wall-clock within the EVM, and doesn't include VM or EVM startup, but incules all excution.

excerpts.author: timbeiko
excerpts.content:
Yesterday, I went over the Electra/Prague thread on EthMag (and the CL github issue) and both updated the thread with a summary, but also put the proposals so far in visual form. Figured it could be valuable to share here. 

A couple of my takeaways: 
- On the EL side, we have more proposals to sort through than on the CL, although the CL has a greater share of proposals that could affect the EL vs. completely independent ones. 
- Both Verkle and DAS are big enough to probably be their own, largely unique, forks, but nothing else appears to be (although larger clusters such as EOF and SSZ could, in aggregate). 

We can get into this more on ACDE, but hopefully this provides a good basis for teams to start using for prioritization!
